dedupe_keys.name: ccnr market observation for european inland navigation annual reports and statistical annex

description: The Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine publishes the Market Observation of European inland navigation, an annual report and a spring market insight, plus thematic reports chosen with the European Commission; the Commission has co-financed the data collection since 2005, which extended it from the Rhine to the whole European waterway network. Coverage: European inland waterways with a focus on the Rhine; the web statistical annex gives yearly Rhine transport volume by goods segment (mineral oil products, sands and gravel, chemicals, containers, agricultural products, iron ore, coal, metals) from 2014 to 2025, transport volume and passing cargo vessels at measurement points such as Emmerich on the Dutch-German border for 2022 to 2025, Rhine fleet tables, low water days, river cruise movements and port data; the reports cover freight and passenger transport and operating conditions, and each spring market insight has a country focus (the Netherlands in April 2026). Format and access: web chapters and HTML tables on inland-navigation-market.org and PDF reports in English, French, German and Dutch, free. Licence: not stated on the legal notice read, which only disclaims liability. Caveats: the annex draws on Destatis, Rijkswaterstaat and other national statistics offices listed on the sources page, so figures can differ from the originals; the 2026 thematic report on new markets was not yet available. Simulation uses: freight volumes, fleet and low-water statistics for inland waterway network flow, capacity planning and drought adaptation of Rhine shipping. Related records: the STORM-Rhine model (model-storm-rhine) and Polish inland waterways portal (data-poland-wir-inland-waterways-portal).
